items.text: Ngomnyaka wamashumi amabili nanhlanu wokuthunjwa kwethu, ekuqaleni konyaka, ngolweshumi lwenyanga, ngomnyaka weshumi nane emva kokunqotshwa komuzi, ngalona lolo suku isandla sikaJehova saba phezu kwami, wangiyisa khona.
Emehlweni kaNkulunkulu wangingenisa elizweni lakoIsrayeli wangimisa entabeni ende kakhulu, eduze kwayo yayinjengogange lomuzi eningizimu.
Wangiyisa khona; bheka, kwakukhona umuntu okubonakala kunjengethusi, ephethe umucu wefilakisi esandleni sakhe, nodondolo lokulinganisa; wema esangweni.

Lowomuntu wathi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, bheka ngamehlo akho, uzwe ngezindlebe zakho, uqondise inhliziyo yakho kukho konke engiyakukukhombisa khona; ngoba ulethwe lapha ngenjongo yokukutshengisa; tshela indlu ka-Israyeli konke okubonayo.

Kwakukhona ugange ngaphandle kwendlu nxazonke, nasesandleni somuntu kukhona induku yokulinganisa ubude buyingalo nobubanzi besandla; walinganisa ububanzi besakhiwo: umhlanga munye; nokuphakama, umhlanga munye.
Yafika esangweni elibheke ngasempumalanga, yakhuphuka ngezitebhisi zalo, yalinganisa umbundu wesango, wawuluhlanga olulodwa ububanzi; lomunye umbundu wesango wawumhlanga owodwa ububanzi.
Ikamelo ngalinye laliwumhlanga owodwa ubude nobubanzi bomhlanga munye; phakathi kwamakamelo kwakuyizingalo eziyisihlanu; umbundu wesango evarandeni yesango ngaphakathi wawuluhlanga lunye.
Walinganisa umpheme wesango ngaphakathi, umhlanga munye.
Yalinganisa umpheme wesango, izingalo eziyisishiyagalombili; nezinsika zalo: yizingalo ezimbili; umpheme wesango wawungaphakathi.
Amakamelo esango ngasempumalanga ayemathathu ngalapha, emathathu nangalapha; zontathu zaziyisilinganiso sinye, nezinsika zomnyango zinesilinganiso sinye ngapha nangapha.
Yalinganisa ububanzi bomnyango wesango: yizingalo eziyishumi; ubude besango buyizingalo eziyishumi nantathu.
Indawo phambi kwamakamelo yayiyingalo eyodwa ngalapha, nendawo yayiyingalo ngalapha; amakamelo ayizingalo eziyisithupha ngalapha nezingalo eziyisithupha ngalapha.
Yalinganisa isango kusukela ophahleni lwegumbi elincane kuze kufike ophahleni lwelinye: ububanzi buyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu, umnyango ngendlu.
Wenza nezinsika zomnyango eziyizingalo ezingamashumi ayisithupha, kuze kube sensikeni yomnyango wegceke nxazonke zesango.
Kusukela ngaphambi kwesango lokungena ukuya ngaphambi kompheme wesango elingaphakathi kwakuyizingalo ezingamashumi amahlanu.

Kwakukhona amafasitele ayingcingo emakamelweni nasezinsikeni zawo ngaphakathi kwesango nxazonke, kanjalo nasemphemelweni; amafasitele ayekhona nxazonke ngaphakathi, nasezinsikeni zeminyango kwakukhona amasundu.
Wayesengiyisa egcekeni elingaphandle; bheka, kwakukhona amakamelo nendawo egandayo yegceke nxazonke; amakamelo angamashumi amathathu ayesendaweni egandayiweyo.
Umgandayo owawusohlangothini lwamasango maqondana nobude bamasango wawungumgandayo ophansi.
Yalinganisa ububanzi kusukela ngaphambi kwesango eliphansi kuze kufike ngaphambi kwegceke elingaphakathi ngaphandle, izingalo eziyikhulu ngasempumalanga nasenyakatho.
Isango legceke elingaphandle elibheke enyakatho, yalinganisa ubude nobubanzi balo.

Amakamelo akhe amancane ayemathathu ngalapha, emathathu nangalapha; nezinsika zalo nezinsika zalo zazinjengesilinganiso sesango lokuqala; ubude balo buyizingalo ezingamashumi ayisihlanu, nobubanzi balo buyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Amafasitele alo, neminyango yawo, namasundu alo kwakungokwesilinganiso sesango elibheke ngasempumalanga; bakhuphukela kulo ngezitebhisi eziyisikhombisa; nompheme wakhe wawuphambi kwazo.
Isango legceke elingaphakathi lalibhekene nesango elingasenyakatho nangasempumalanga; walinganisa kusukela esangweni kuze kufike esangweni, izingalo eziyikhulu.
Ngemva kwalokho wangiyisa eningizimu, futhi kwakukhona isango eningizimu; yalinganisa izinsika zalo zomnyango nompheme walo njengezilinganiso zalo.
Kwakukhona amafasitele kulo nasemphemeni walo nxazonke njengalawo mafasitele; ubude buyizingalo ezingamashumi ayisihlanu, nobubanzi buyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Kwakukhona izinyathelo eziyisikhombisa zokukhuphukela kulo, umpheme walo wawuphambi kwazo; lalinamasundu, elinye ngalapha nelinye ngalapha ezinsikeni zalo zomnyango.
Kwakukhona isango egcekeni elingaphakathi ngaseningizimu, walinganisa kusukela esangweni kuye esangweni ukuya eningizimu, izingalo eziyikhulu.
Wayesengingenisa egcekeni elingaphakathi ngesango laseningizimu; yalinganisa isango laseningizimu njengezilinganiso zalo;

Amakamelo alo amancane, nezinsika zalo zeminyango, neminyango yalo njengalezi zilinganiso; kwakukhona amafasitele kulo nasemphemeni walo nxazonke; ubude balo buyizingalo ezingamashumi ayisihlanu, nobubanzi buyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Umpheme nxazonke wawuyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu ubude nezingalo ezinhlanu ububanzi.
Umpheme wakhe wawubheke egcekeni elingaphandle; amasundu ayephezu kwezinsika zomnyango walo, futhi umnyango walo wawunezinyathelo eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wayesengingenisa egcekeni elingaphakathi ngasempumalanga; yalinganisa isango ngezilinganiso zalo.

Amakamelo alo amancane, nezinsika zalo zeminyango, neminyango yalo kwakukhona nalezi zilinganiso; kwakukhona amafasitele kulo nasemphemeni walo nxazonke; ubude balo buyizingalo ezingamashumi ayisihlanu, nobubanzi buyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Umpheme wakhe wawubheke egcekeni elingaphandle; namasundu ayesezinsikeni zeminyango yalo, ngapha nangapha; ukukhuphukela kulo kwakunezinyathelo eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wangiyisa eSangweni Lasenyakatho, walilinganisa njengezilinganiso zalezi zilinganiso;
amagumbi alo, nezinsika zalo, neminyango yalo, namafasitele alo nxazonke; ubude buyizingalo ezingamashumi ayisihlanu, nobubanzi buyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Izinsika zalo zazibheke egcekeni elingaphandle; namasundu ayesezinsikeni zeminyango yalo, ngapha nangapha; ukukhuphukela kulo kwakunezinyathelo eziyisishiyagalombili.
Amakamelo neminyango yawo kwakusezinsikeni zeminyango yamasango, lapho babegezela khona umnikelo wokushiswa.
Emphemeni wesango kwakukhona amatafula amabili ngalapha namatafula amabili ngalapha okuhlatshwa umnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wesono nomnikelo wecala.
Ngaphandle, uma umuntu ekhuphukela ekungeneni kwesango lasenyakatho, kwakukhona amatafula amabili; ngakolunye uhlangothi olungasemphemeni wesango kwakukhona amatafula amabili.
Amatafula amane ayengalapha namatafula amane ngakolunye uhlangothi, ohlangothini lwesango; amatafula ayisishiyagalombili ababehlabela kuwo imihlatshelo yabo.

Amatafula amane omnikelo wokushiswa ayengamatshe aqoshiwe, ubude buyingalo nengxenye, ububanzi buyingalo nenxenye, ukuphakama kube yingalo; ababeka phezu kwazo amathuluzi ababehlaba ngawo umnikelo wokushiswa kanye nesisulu.
Kwakukhona izingwegwe ezingangobubanzi besandla ngaphakathi, ziboshwe nxazonke; phezu kwamatafula kukhona inyama yomhlatshelo.

Ngaphandle kwesango elingaphakathi kwakukhona amakamelo abahlabeleli egcekeni elingaphakathi ohlangothini lwesango lasenyakatho; umbono wawo wawubheke eningizimu, elinye lisohlangothini lwesango lasempumalanga, libheke enyakatho.
Wathi kimi: “Leli kamelo elibheke ngaseningizimu ngelabapristi abagcina inkonzo yendlu.”
Ikamelo elibheke ngasenyakatho ngelabapristi abagcina inkonzo ye-altare; ngamadodana kaSadoki phakathi kwamadodana kaLevi asondela kuJehova ukuba amkhonze.
Walinganisa igceke: ubude balo buyizingalo eziyikhulu, ububanzi buyizingalo eziyikhulu; ne-altare elaliphambi kwendlu.

Wayesengingenisa emphemeni wendlu, walinganisa umnyango wompheme: yizingalo eziyisihlanu ngalapha nezingalo eziyisihlanu ngalapha; ububanzi besango babuyizingalo ezintathu ngalapha nezingalo ezintathu kolunye uhlangothi uleyisi.

Ubude bompheme babuyizingalo ezingamashumi amabili, nobubanzi buyizingalo eziyishumi nanye; wangiyisa ezitebhisini ababekhuphuke ngazo kulo, kwakukhona izinsika ezinsikeni zomnyango, enye ngalapha nenye ngalapha.
